content.title: Microsoft Surface Pro | Powerful Laptop & Tablet Combination
content.text: Microsoft Surface Devices Designed to improve performance for any team, anywhere. Microsoft Surface devices enable high-impact work through innovative design, exceptional performance, on-the-go connectivity and chip-to-cloud security. Laptops designed by Microsoft. Built for Business. Inspired by the way you work. The modern workplace requires performance, versatility, accessibility and new technologies that enable every employee to drive productivity. Microsoft Surface devices are thoughtfully built, adapting to how teams work, learn and create. Through CDW’s extensive expertise with Microsoft 365, Microsoft for Education, Azure, and Copilot, CDW and Surface can help give your team the freedom to work their way. The new Surface portfolio, powered by Windows 11, is your catalyst to digital transformation while maintaining powerful security, exceptional accessibility features, sustainability measures & repairability capabilities. CDW is proud to offer the entire portfolio of Surface devices, including the new Surface for Business PCs featuring either Intel Core Ultra (series 2) technology or Qualcomm ARM processors, along with the Surface Laptop Go 3, Surface Go 4, Surface Laptop Studio 2 and Surface accessories. Key Features and Functionality Repairability New repairability and serviceability capabilities can extend the lifespan of your Microsoft Surface devices. Accessibility Inclusively designed Surface products and Adaptive Accessories are a true platform for accessibility, enabling equitable outcomes for all. Sustainability Microsoft has a commitment to be carbon negative, water positive and zero waste by 2030. Surface plays a key role in achieving these goals. Security Gain peace of mind with Secured-core PCs featuring Windows 11 Pro security features enabled by default. Surface Copilot+ PCs, powered by Intel Core Ultra (series 2) Surface Copilot+ PCs with Intel Core Ultra processors (series 2) help employees maximize efficiency, drive innovation and lay the foundation for an AI-enabled future. Elevate productivity with user-focused design, powerful processing and innovative on-device AI. Stay productive anywhere with fast performance, all-day power and 5G connectivity. Streamline workflows with fast performance, all-day battery and a premium design. Unlock flexibility with this Intel-powered 2-in-1 designed for modern work. Surface Copilot+ PCs powered by Qualcomm Snapdragon Powered by Snapdragon, Surface Copilot+ PCs help employees unlock AI-driven productivity, seamless mobility and all-day performance— all in one sleek device Slim, silent and sophisticated— Surface Laptop is built to impress from every angle. Powered by Snapdragon, Surface Laptop is optimized for Copilot+ and AI experiences. Built to go wherever work takes you— Surface Pro pairs iconic flexibility with AI-first power. Sustainable by design. Surface Pro with Snapdragon X Elite helps reduce waste without compromising power. $2,199.99 $2,056.99Advertised Price Shop Now Surface and Windows 11 Get pro-level performance on the Windows 11 secured Surface devices. Let Surface & Windows 11 help you gain productivity with updated mode detection, inking experiences and tactile feedback. Plus, unleash productivity with Intel Core Ultra (Series 2) processers, delivering an optimal balance of power efficiency, performance and dedicated AI acceleration. Surface Accessories Maximize your workspace with Surface accessories— including the versatile dock, tactile keyboard, precision mouse and natural-feel pen— all designed to complement the way you work. Surface Docks provide powerful, adaptable solutions designed to help professionals stay organized & connected Surface Keyboards offer thoughtfully designed devices delivering a premium typing experience. The intuitive Surface Pen supports creativity, collaboration and digital productivity. With smooth, responsive control, the Surface Mouse family supports productivity.
